description: Find a prior job in the workspace-bound project when you do not have its id. intent is recent, failed, or reusable. This list never includes prompt text. To read the prompt that was executed, call hydracept_job_inspect and read executedPrompt (requestSnapshot.input.prompt). Bind the project that owns the job before searching. Auth: bearer required. Cost: none. Side effects: none.

capability_key.description: Optional filter to one capability key.
capability_key.title: Capability Key

intent.description: Required enum: recent, failed, or reusable.
intent.title: Intent

project_id.description: Optional project scope;Optional; when omitted inherits projectId/environment from authenticated MCP session.
project_id.title: Project Id

name: hydracept_jobs_find
title: Find a prior job
